name: GitHub Trending Scout
tagline: A daily digest of the trending repos that match your stack
description: Each morning it walks GitHub's trending page and keeps only the projects touching the languages and tools you actually work in. What arrives is a short read: a line or two per repository on what it does and why someone with your setup would care, so you skim a page instead of scrolling hundreds.
author: Hussein_M_Ragab
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
